actions.email_confirme: Email confirmed: the record and the interaction are up to date.

card.le_sens_decide_de_l_arret_automatique: An email coming from the contact stops automatic sending to them.
card.proposition_deterministe: Proposal made without a model: phone by pattern, name from the header.
card.proposition_du_modele: Proposal from a model, based on the last lines of the message: nothing is written until you confirm.
card.rattacher_ne_modifie_pas_la_fiche: Linking does not change the existing record: only the interaction is added to it.

page.aucune_adresse_encore: No ingestion address yet: <link>create it in the settings</link>, then forward an email to that address.
page.ce_que_l_adresse_d_ingestion_a_recu: What the ingestion address has received.
page.cet_ecran_appartient_a_une_organisation: Received emails belong to an organization: pick one in the top banner.

emptyHint.pending: Forward an email to your ingestion address, or put it in blind copy when you write to a contact: the proposal shows up here.
emptyHint.rejected: A rejected email appears here with its reason — unknown address, sender not a member, sender not authenticated, rate or size.
emptyHint.treated: Confirmed and ignored emails end up here, with the record they were linked to.

page.transfere_a_ou_mets_en_copie: Forward an email to {address}, or put that address in blind copy: the proposal shows up here.
